BPSC postpones 72nd CCE preliminary exam

The Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has postponed its 72nd Combined Competitive Examination (CCE) preliminary test, which was scheduled for July 26. The commission has not yet provided a reason for the postponement or announced a new date for the exam. This decision affects candidates preparing for the examination.
